data.desc: Reinsurance Group of America, Incorporated (NYSE: RGA) is a global industry leader specializing in life and health reinsurance and financial solutions that help clients effectively manage risk and optimize capital. Founded in 1973, RGA is one of the world's largest and most respected reinsurers and remains guided by a powerful purpose: to make financial protection accessible to all. As a global capabilities and solutions leader, RGA empowers partners through bold innovation, relentless execution, and dedicated client focus - all directed toward creating sustainable long-term value. RGA has approximately $4.4 trillion of life reinsurance in force and total assets of $169.5 billion as of September 30, 2026. To learn more about RGA and its businesses, please visit www.rgare.com or follow RGA on LinkedIn and Facebook . Investors can learn more at investor.rgare.com.
